I want to share my positive experience with Sym Clinic for anyone looking for quality cosmetic procedures, whether you're entering the world of injections for the first time or have already tried many doctors and clinics. I went for Botox to reduce wrinkles on my eyebrows, forehead, crow's feet, and nose. It was my first time getting Botox. I spent a long time choosing the clinic because I'm terrified of needles. More importantly, I was afraid my face would look stiff and unnatural, unlike what I've seen on others. I researched for a long time.

I chose this clinic because the doctor is a professor with extensive experience. The doctor's face looked naturally beautiful (some places advertise well, but the doctor's face isn't suitable – too stiff, swollen, or fake – so I didn't dare go there for fear of looking like the doctor).

I was very impressed. It hurt less than I expected because I asked the doctor to apply numbing cream before the injection. Thank you to the doctor and staff for not being bothered by my fear of needles.

The results look very natural. They offer a selection of Korean, British, and American brands, all FDA-approved.
Prices vary from a few thousand to tens of thousands of baht.
You can choose according to your budget.

The doctor also included a complimentary collagen treatment. So relaxing! My skin is glowing and beautiful.
